pages.text: Powered, it throws a cart into the air, keeping its forward speed, to sail over a gap or onto a higher track.

**Height** follows signal strength: about **8 blocks** at 15, half a block less per level. Use a comparator or target block to tune it. The pads light up when powered.

It doesn't pass power on. On the way up a cart ignores rails; from the top of its arc it can land again.
